business_purpose: Records the profile and static financial state of a consumer at the exact moment they apply for credit.
business_question_supported: What are the core demographic and financial attributes of the applicant at the time of submission?
grain: One record per applicant transaction event (applicant_id).
storage_and_ingestion: Daily incremental batch upload appended into a raw data warehouse landing zone without early stage data masking.
ai_consumption: Utilized directly as a model training feature input to predict default probability.
ai_assumption: Assumes the applicant-declared income and employment state are verified truths.

columns.business_meaning: Unique system identifier for an applicant's submission event used to connect to credit checks and underwriting tables.
The precise calendar date on which the credit application was submitted.
Self-reported or verified gross annual income of the applicant at the time of submission.
The occupational standing of the applicant used to gauge stable repayment capacity.
